title: Build interpreter-grounded Scheme factorial vignette

progress.summary: Approved interpreter-grounded factorial direction, 24-slice v2 contract, project-memory pivot, and recoverable algebra pause are durable; next slice audits old and current Lisp seams.

expectedLearning: Whether interpreter-certified causal identity can support a more pedagogical recursion score than literal execution order.
Whether suspended code shells and one return-value lineage make recursive descent and unwind immediately legible.
Whether native searchable code and transient overlays can remain smooth under direct seek, reverse, narrow layout, and reduced motion.
allowedWork: The approved factorial-local evaluator, trace, score, choreography, renderer, route, and evidence.
disallowedWork: No existing Lisp replacement, general language framework, live evaluator, editor, curriculum expansion, or unrelated visual work.
